sn55.61:2.1: vassaṁvutthaṁ dhammadinnañca gilānaṁ → vassavutthaṁ dhammadinnagilāyanaṁ (sya-all) | Vassavutthaṁ → S3 vassaṁvuttha. (pts note)
sn55.61:2.4: vuddhi vepullatāya cāti → vuḍḍhī vepullanāmikoti (bj) | vuddhi → vuḍḍhi (sya-all) | cāti → cā ti mahāpaññattāya (pts) | Vuddhi → S1 vuddhī. (pts note) | ti → This uddāna is to be found in the Singhalese MSS. only. (pts note) | Mahāpaññattāya → B1 paññatāya always. (pts note)
